cosmosPayDev.cardKeysBody: Authenticate server-to-server calls. The full secret is only shown once when the key is created.
cosmosPayDev.cardLinksBody: Amounts in USDC. Each link has a public URL; archive links you no longer need.
cosmosPayDev.cardDocsBody: Base URL, headers, and cURL examples to create links from your server.
cosmosPayDev.keysDescription: Use the X-API-Key header on the link-creation endpoint. Revoke a key if it is exposed.
cosmosPayDev.keysEmpty: No keys yet. Create one to get started.
cosmosPayDev.keysRevokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Integrations using it will stop working.
cosmosPayDev.keysSecretWarn: It will not be shown again. Store it in a secret manager or environment variables.
cosmosPayDev.linksDescription: Create fixed-amount links. Share the URL or integrate via API from your backend.
cosmosPayDev.linksDescriptionUsdc: All amounts are in USDC. Manage links, copy the public URL, and archive those you no longer need.
cosmosPayDev.linksEmptyHint: Create a link with an amount in USDC and share the URL with your customer.
cosmosPayDev.linksSearchPlaceholder: Search by title, slug, or description…
cosmosPayDev.linksUsdcHint: The amount is stored in USDC. Other currencies are not supported.
cosmosPayDev.linksSlugLocked: The slug cannot be changed so existing shared links keep working.
cosmosPayDev.docsIntro: All endpoints use your API prefix (e.g. /api/v1). Replace BASE and your key in the examples.
cosmosPayDev.docsCalloutBody: Replace BASE with your API URL (including the /api/v1 prefix). The X-API-Key header must only be used on the server—never in the browser.
cosmosPayDev.docsQuickStartLead: Accept payments in three steps: API key, create the link from your backend, then share the public checkout URL.
cosmosPayDev.docsQuickStep1Body: In API Keys, generate a key and store the cosmospay__ secret in environment variables or a secrets manager.
cosmosPayDev.docsQuickStep2Body: From your server, POST to /cosmos-pay/v1/payment-links with JSON (e.g. title and amount in USDC) and the X-API-Key header.
cosmosPayDev.docsQuickStep3Body: Use the returned slug in the public checkout URL. The public GET does not require an API key.
cosmosPayDev.docsBaseLead: Set VITE_API_URL in the frontend so requests hit your backend. Current value (development):
cosmosPayDev.docsPostLead: Required header: X-API-Key with your cosmospay__… secret.
cosmosPayDev.docsGetLead: No authentication. Returns title, USDC amount, and description for the payment page.
cosmosPayDev.docsJwtLead: Endpoints under /cosmos-pay/dev/* require the same Bearer token as the rest of the API (signed-in session).
cosmosPayDev.accountLead: Unify how you sign in: email, Google, and Stellar wallet—aligned with the broader Cosmos experience.
cosmosPayDev.accountIdentitiesHint: You can combine several methods on the same account and sign in with whichever you prefer.
cosmosPayDev.accountGoogleDesc: Google sign-in when you used it to register or log in.
cosmosPayDev.accountWalletDesc: Connect Freighter or another supported wallet and link it to your profile.
cosmosPayDev.accountLinkWalletLead: Connect your wallet and sign the message to attach it to this account—same model as Cosmos: one identity, multiple ways in.
cosmosPayDev.accountWalletAlready: This wallet was already linked to your account.
cosmosPayDev.accountErrSign: Your wallet could not sign the message.
cosmosPayDev.accountErrRejected: Signing was cancelled in the wallet. Try again.
cosmosPayDev.accountErrOtherUser: This address is already linked to another account.
cosmosPayDev.payCtaNote: Payment is processed securely through Cosmos. If you have questions, contact the merchant who sent you this link.
cosmosPayDev.payInvalid: This link is not available or has been archived.
cosmosPayDev.errorLoad: Could not load. Check your connection or that the backend migration has been applied.
cosmosPayDev.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
